extensionDescription.message: Keeps GitHub's English terms and adds small Japanese labels, concept tooltips and a page guide. Bodies are translated on-device only when you ask.

translationEnabledStatus.message: ON: Show Japanese help on GitHub

contentTranslationLabel.message: "Read in Japanese" button for README / Issue / PR

contentTranslationNote.message: Bodies are translated only when you press the button, on this device, by Chrome's built-in translator. Nothing is sent to other servers.

globalHeaderTranslationToggleLabel.message: Enable or disable global header translation

globalHeaderTranslationWarning.message: If the global search stops opening (e.g. right after the browser starts), turn this off.

languageListLoadError.message: Unable to load the language list

reportButton.message: Copy untranslated text on this page

reportNote.message: Copies the visible labels that still have no Japanese and the page type (names hidden, e.g. /<user-name>/<repo-name>/issues). Nothing is sent. Page text can slip in, so check it before sending it to the developer.

reportCopied.message: Copied $COUNT$ items. Paste them into your message.

reportUnavailable.message: Open a GitHub page (with Japanese assist on and a display mode other than English only), then try again.
